description: This file is a shell script containing a series of test cases for Git checkout command behavior, including ambiguity handling, branch switching, and error messaging.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case that expects success, runs the provided commands, and reports success if they pass.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Runs the command expecting it to fail; used for testing error conditions.

methods.name: test_grep
methods.description: Checks whether specific pattern(s) are present in the output or error streams.

methods.name: test_done
methods.description: Marks the end of the test script.
